meta.name: geniml
meta.description: Use Geniml for audited local genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证并规划本地基因组间隔工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理基因组数据并需要验证BED文件
copy.tagline_en: Validate and plan local genomic-interval workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with genomic data and need to validate BED files

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会针对你的基因组区间(BED)数据给出geniml的具体用法:提供安装命令、Python代码和CLI命令,指导训练Region2Vec或scEmbed嵌入、构建公共峰集(universe),并检查模型与数据是否匹配。
howto.when: 当你要处理BED文件并做机器学习分析时触发,例如训练区域嵌入(Region2Vec/BEDspace)、分析单细胞ATAC-seq(scEmbed)、构建共识峰集等。

say.text: 帮我用Region2Vec训练这批BED文件的区域嵌入
say.note: Claude会指导tokenize、训练和评估的完整流程。

say.text: 用scEmbed分析我的单细胞ATAC-seq数据
say.note: Claude会给出从数据加载到聚类的步骤。

say.text: 检查一下我的universe文件和BED数据是否匹配
say.note: Claude会验证兼容性并提示问题。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude helps you use geniml for BED ML tasks: gives install/CLI commands and Python code, trains Region2Vec/scEmbed, builds universes, checks compatibility.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you work with BED files for ML, e.g., training region embeddings (Region2Vec/BEDspace), analyzing scATAC-seq (scEmbed), or building consensus universes.

say_en.text: Help me train Region2Vec embeddings on these BED files
say_en.note: Claude will walk through tokenization, training, and evaluation.

say_en.text: Use scEmbed to analyze my single-cell ATAC-seq data
say_en.note: Claude gives steps from loading data to clustering.

say_en.text: Check if my universe file matches these BED data
say_en.note: Claude validates compatibility and flags issues.
